entry.title: Rotary embeddings in small language models
entry.summary: We study rotary position embeddings in a small Transformer language model. Rotary position embeddings lower validation loss compared with learned absolute positions. Code is released.

entry.title: SwiGLU feed-forward blocks for character-level Transformers
entry.summary: SwiGLU feed-forward blocks improve a character-level Transformer language model at equal parameter count. We report results on several corpora.

entry.title: A survey of normalization in deep networks
entry.summary: This survey reviews normalization layers in deep neural networks. We organize prior work by architecture and task.

entry.title: RMSNorm in a vision transformer for image recognition
entry.summary: We evaluate RMSNorm in a vision transformer on image classification benchmarks.
